title: 第十二章同样的理由第十三章逃离小月宗
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: “这里应该没有问题了吧？收着一点力，应该不至于惊动那些巡逻弟子。”
江离来到山崖处停了下来。
环顾四周，最终点点头，此处环境他还是比较满意。
此处便是他平时倾倒炉灰的那片山崖，因为没有别的路可走，所以平时也不会有巡逻弟子来这里查看。
正好适合测试术法威力。
借着微弱的月光，江离瞄准了一棵长在山崖峭壁上的歪脖树。
江离深呼一口气，体内灵力运转而出，很快便在他手中汇聚成一团火球。
这次的火球比他初次凝聚的还要小上一些。
没办法。
他也不知道这火弹术的威力到底如何，自然要收着点力。
万一惊动了别人，可就不好了。
火球在江离手中不断跳动，有种随时都要脱离他的掌控一般。
江离不再过多耽搁。
一声轻喝，火球瞬间从江离手心之中弹出，奔着那棵歪脖树便飞了过去。
三丈之外，火球猛地撞上那棵成人手腕粗的歪脖树。
砰！
爆炸声传来。
成人手腕粗的歪脖树的主干应声断裂。
要知道长在悬崖峭壁上的树木天生就比普通树木坚硬许多。
一个火弹术便可将其一分为二，不敢想这要是打在人身上会是什么样。
火球爆炸开来，爆炸的火星溅射在周围的岩石上，江离竟发现，岩石表面竟也燃烧起来。
数个呼吸后，岩石表面的火焰才逐渐熄灭。
反倒是那棵歪脖树依旧在不断燃烧，噼啪作响。
就连江离也能感觉到一股热浪迎着他的面门扑了过来。
要知道，这还是江离没有发挥出全力的结果。
“厉害！果然厉害！”
“低阶术法就已经这么厉害了，那些高阶术法得厉害到什么程度。”
江流本想再打几发术法，最后还是生生的忍耐住了心中的骚动，返回了住处。
回到住所后，江离观察了许久外面的动静，最终确定他测试火弹术的动静没有引起别人的注意，这才放下心来。
躺在床上，江离开始盘算。
以他现在的能力，连续全力打出十来发火弹术后，他体内的灵力就会被消耗一空。
也就是说，如果十来次攻击无法解决掉敌人，那他就只有任人鱼肉的份了。
想着想着，江离就睡了过去。
测试术法这件事也便这么揭了过去，始终没有被人发现。
content_en:
"There should be no problem here, right? If you hold back a little, you shouldn't disturb the patrolling disciples."
Jiang Li came to the cliff and stopped.
Looking around, he finally nodded. He was quite satisfied with the environment here.
This is the cliff where he usually dumps the ashes. Since there is no other way to go, no patrolling disciples usually come here to check.
Just right for testing the power of spells.
With the faint moonlight, Jiang Li aimed at a crooked-necked tree growing on the cliff.
"Get up..."
Jiang Li took a deep breath, and the spiritual power in his body circulated, and soon it gathered into a ball of fire in his hand.
This time the fireball was smaller than the one he condensed the first time.
no way.
He didn't know how powerful this fire bomb technique was, so he naturally had to hold back.
It would be bad if it alarmed others.
The fireball kept beating in Jiang Li's hand, as if it would escape his control at any moment.
Jiang Li stopped delaying too much.
"Go!"
With a soft drink, the fireball instantly popped out of Jiang Li's hand and flew towards the crooked-neck tree.
Three feet away, the fireball slammed into the crooked-neck tree, which was as thick as an adult's wrist.
Bang!
There was an explosion.
The main trunk of the crooked neck tree, which was as thick as an adult's wrist, snapped.
You must know that trees growing on cliffs are inherently much harder than ordinary trees.
A fire bomb can split it in two. I don't dare to imagine what it would be like if it hit a person.
The fireball exploded, and the explosive sparks splashed on the surrounding rocks. Jiang Li unexpectedly discovered that the surface of the rocks was also burning.
After several breaths, the flames on the rock surface gradually extinguished.
On the contrary, the crooked-neck tree was still burning and crackling.
Even Jiang Li could feel a wave of heat rushing toward his face.
You know, this is still the result of Jiang Li not exerting his full strength.
"Awesome! It's really awesome!"
"Low-level spells are already so powerful, how powerful are those high-level spells?"
Jiang Liu wanted to use a few more spells, but in the end he endured the turmoil in his heart and returned to his residence.
After returning to his residence, Jiang Li observed the movement outside for a long time, and finally felt relieved when he finally determined that the movement of him testing the fire bomb technique did not attract anyone's attention.
Lying on the bed, Jiang Li began to make plans.
With his current ability, after firing a dozen fire bombs with all his strength in a row, the spiritual energy in his body will be exhausted.
In other words, if the enemy cannot be eliminated in a dozen attacks, then he will have no choice but to be a mermaid.
After thinking about it, Jiang Li fell asleep.
The matter of testing the magic was revealed in this way, and no one has ever discovered it.
